links.comparator_used: Same model without conformal prediction (raw point predictions)
links.outcome: Overall prediction errors and identification of potentially persistent ill patients
links.effect: Mixed-confidence CP reduced overall prediction errors by 27.6% (n=62) in the internal validation cohort and 30.7% (n=412) in the external validation cohort; also identified more potentially persistent ill patients
links.quote: Compared to the model without CP, using the model with CP at a mixed confidence approach reduced overall prediction errors by 27.6% (n=62) and 30.7% (n=412) in the internal and external validation cohorts, respectively, as well as enabled the identification of more potentially persistent ill patients.
